# Awesome Agentic Patterns

A curated catalogue of AI agent design patterns.

Every pattern is also available as Markdown at https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/<slug>.md. Full text of all patterns: https://agentic-patterns.com/llms-full.txt. Usage notes for agents: https://agentic-patterns.com/agents.

## Patterns

### 402-first-machine-payments
402-First Machine Payments (Price-Before-Work Tool Purchases): Server returns an HTTP 402 price quote before doing work, and the agent pays the exact amount only if it fits its budget cap
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/402-first-machine-payments
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/402-first-machine-payments.md

### abstracted-code-representation-for-review
Abstracted Code Representation for Review: Shows reviewers pseudocode, intent summaries, and logical diffs of code changes, with drill-down to the real code to confirm the mapping
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/abstracted-code-representation-for-review
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/abstracted-code-representation-for-review.md

### action-caching-replay
Action Caching & Replay Pattern: Records each agent action with XPath and frame metadata so later runs replay it without LLM calls, with LLM fallback when replay fails
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/action-caching-replay
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/action-caching-replay.md

### action-selector-pattern
Action-Selector Pattern: LLM maps user intent to a pre-approved action ID with schema-validated parameters, and tool outputs never return to the selector
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/action-selector-pattern
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/action-selector-pattern.md

### adaptive-sandbox-fanout-controller
Adaptive Sandbox Fan-Out Controller: Starts a small batch of parallel sandboxes, then scales up, stops early, or refines the prompt based on early success, variance, and error signals
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/adaptive-sandbox-fanout-controller
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/adaptive-sandbox-fanout-controller.md

### agent-circuit-breaker
Agent Circuit Breaker: Prevents agents from wasting tokens and time on repeatedly failing tools by tracking failure rates and temporarily disabling broken tool endpoints
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-circuit-breaker
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-circuit-breaker.md

### agent-modes-by-model-personality
Agent Modes by Model Personality: Offers separate working modes, each with its own prompts, tools, UI, and expectations, tuned to one model's working style
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-modes-by-model-personality
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-modes-by-model-personality.md

### agent-reinforcement-fine-tuning
Agent Reinforcement Fine-Tuning (Agent RFT): Trains model weights with reinforcement learning on real tool calls and custom graders to improve domain-specific tool use and multi-step reasoning
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-reinforcement-fine-tuning
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-reinforcement-fine-tuning.md

### agent-sdk-for-programmatic-control
Agent SDK for Programmatic Control: Exposes agent functions through an SDK and CLI so code can run the agent headless with set tools, permissions, and resource limits
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-sdk-for-programmatic-control
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-sdk-for-programmatic-control.md

### agent-assisted-scaffolding
Agent-Assisted Scaffolding: Agent generates initial files, boilerplate, and directory structure from a high-level description so developers start on core logic
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-assisted-scaffolding
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-assisted-scaffolding.md

### agent-driven-research
Agent-Driven Research: Agent plans its own search queries, runs them across sources, reflects on gaps, and iterates until it can write a sourced report
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-driven-research
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-driven-research.md

### agent-first-tool-discovery
Agent-First Tool Discovery: Build search indexes designed for agent consumers, returning structured tool metadata ranked by agent-relevant signals instead of human SEO metrics.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-first-tool-discovery
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-first-tool-discovery.md

### agent-first-tooling-and-logging
Agent-First Tooling and Logging: Designs tools and logs for agent consumption with one unified log stream, structured JSON output, and agent-aware CLI flags
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-first-tooling-and-logging
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-first-tooling-and-logging.md

### agent-friendly-workflow-design
Agent-Friendly Workflow Design: Gives agents clear high-level goals, room for implementation choices, structured I/O, and plan review before execution
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-friendly-workflow-design
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-friendly-workflow-design.md

### agent-powered-codebase-qa-onboarding
Agent-Powered Codebase Q&A / Onboarding: Agent indexes the codebase with embeddings and code graphs and answers natural-language questions about where code is and how it behaves
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-powered-codebase-qa-onboarding
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agent-powered-codebase-qa-onboarding.md

### agentic-search-over-vector-embeddings
Agentic Search Over Vector Embeddings: Replaces vector indexes with agent-driven grep, find, and file traversal that searches current file state on demand and refines iteratively
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agentic-search-over-vector-embeddings
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/agentic-search-over-vector-embeddings.md

### ai-web-search-agent-loop
AI Web Search Agent Loop: Coordinator agent translates queries, spawns parallel search workers across domains and time ranges, refines iteratively, and answers with citations
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/ai-web-search-agent-loop
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/ai-web-search-agent-loop.md

### ai-accelerated-learning-and-skill-development
AI-Accelerated Learning and Skill Development: Uses AI assistants as tutors that explain errors and concepts, offer alternatives, and fade support as the developer gains skill
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/ai-accelerated-learning-and-skill-development
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/ai-accelerated-learning-and-skill-development.md

### ai-assisted-code-review-verification
AI-Assisted Code Review / Verification: Uses AI tools to flag issues, summarize change intent, and explain code so human reviewers focus on intent and business logic
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/ai-assisted-code-review-verification
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/ai-assisted-code-review-verification.md

### anti-reward-hacking-grader-design
Anti-Reward-Hacking Grader Design: Design reward functions with multi-criteria evaluation and iterative hardening to prevent models from gaming graders, ensuring training rewards align with actual task quality.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/anti-reward-hacking-grader-design
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/anti-reward-hacking-grader-design.md

### multi-step-analysis-pipeline-orchestration
Artifact-Driven Analysis Pipeline Orchestration: Has an agent run independent analysis scripts, read their structured reports, and merge them into one final report or visualization
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/multi-step-analysis-pipeline-orchestration
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/multi-step-analysis-pipeline-orchestration.md

### asynchronous-coding-agent-pipeline
Asynchronous Coding Agent Pipeline: Splits inference, tool execution, reward modeling, and learning into asynchronous workers linked by message queues so GPUs stay busy
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/asynchronous-coding-agent-pipeline
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/asynchronous-coding-agent-pipeline.md

### authenticated-authority-channel
Authenticated Authority Channel: Preserve a distinguishable channel for authenticated intent so retrieved content can inform reasoning without granting itself authority.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/authenticated-authority-channel
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/authenticated-authority-channel.md

### autonomous-workflow-agent-architecture
Autonomous Workflow Agent Architecture: Runs multi-step engineering workflows in containers with tmux sessions, adaptive monitoring, checkpoints, and context-aware error recovery
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/autonomous-workflow-agent-architecture
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/autonomous-workflow-agent-architecture.md

### background-agent-ci
Background Agent with CI Feedback: Runs the agent in the background on its own branch and uses CI results as feedback to patch failures until green or blocked
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/background-agent-ci
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/background-agent-ci.md

### black-box-skill-invocation
Black-Box Skill Invocation: Shares skills through input and output schemas only and runs them on the provider side, so prompts and code never cross the boundary
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/black-box-skill-invocation
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/black-box-skill-invocation.md

### board-mediated-inter-agent-coordination
Board-Mediated Async Inter-Agent Coordination: Routes agent-to-agent messages through comment threads on board cards, with a prefix that creates an inbox card to notify the target agent
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/board-mediated-inter-agent-coordination
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/board-mediated-inter-agent-coordination.md

### budget-aware-model-routing-with-hard-cost-caps
Budget-Aware Model Routing with Hard Cost Caps: Routes each request to the cheapest model that meets its needs under hard cost caps, and escalates only when quality gates fail
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/budget-aware-model-routing-with-hard-cost-caps
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/budget-aware-model-routing-with-hard-cost-caps.md

### burn-the-boats
Burn the Boats: Removes working but obsolete features on a hard, announced deadline so the team and users move to the new approach
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/burn-the-boats
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/burn-the-boats.md

### canary-rollout-and-automatic-rollback-for-agent-policy-changes
Canary Rollout and Automatic Rollback for Agent Policy Changes: Ships agent policy changes to a small traffic slice first, monitors guardrail metrics, and rolls back to the last stable version automatically
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/canary-rollout-and-automatic-rollback-for-agent-policy-changes
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/canary-rollout-and-automatic-rollback-for-agent-policy-changes.md

### capability-escrow-receipt
Capability-Escrow-Receipt: Binds a signed capability listing, an atomic escrow-plus-hire step, and a signed work receipt into one loop for agent-to-agent payment
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/capability-escrow-receipt
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/capability-escrow-receipt.md

### chain-of-thought-monitoring-interruption
Chain-of-Thought Monitoring & Interruption: Streams agent reasoning and tool calls in real time so a human can interrupt and redirect early when the approach is wrong
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/chain-of-thought-monitoring-interruption
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/chain-of-thought-monitoring-interruption.md

### classify-then-act-for-background-agents
Classify-Then-Act for Background Agents: Sorts each task into has-default, needs-intent, or out-of-scope, builds only has-default work in a sandbox, and queues it for human review
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/classify-then-act-for-background-agents
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/classify-then-act-for-background-agents.md

### cli-first-skill-design
CLI-First Skill Design: Builds each skill as a standalone CLI with JSON output and exit codes so humans and agents use the same interface
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cli-first-skill-design
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cli-first-skill-design.md

### cli-native-agent-orchestration
CLI-Native Agent Orchestration: Exposes agent capabilities as CLI commands with JSON output and exit codes so Makefiles, Git hooks, cron jobs, and CI can script and replay agent runs
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cli-native-agent-orchestration
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cli-native-agent-orchestration.md

### code-first-tool-interface-pattern
Code Mode MCP Tool Interface Improvement Pattern: LLMs generate TypeScript code to orchestrate MCP tools in ephemeral V8 isolates, eliminating token-heavy round-trips and enabling efficient multi-step workflows with 10x+ token savings.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/code-first-tool-interface-pattern
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/code-first-tool-interface-pattern.md

### code-over-api-pattern
Code-Over-API Pattern: Agent writes code that calls tools and filters data inside a sandbox, so only summaries and samples return to the context window
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/code-over-api-pattern
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/code-over-api-pattern.md

### code-then-execute-pattern
Code-Then-Execute Pattern: LLM writes a sandboxed program or DSL script, a static taint checker verifies data flows, and an interpreter runs it in a locked sandbox
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/code-then-execute-pattern
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/code-then-execute-pattern.md

### codebase-optimization-for-agents
Codebase Optimization for Agents: Optimizes tooling, CLIs, tests, and docs for agents first, with one-command verify loops and machine-readable output, even if human DX regresses
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/codebase-optimization-for-agents
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/codebase-optimization-for-agents.md

### coding-agent-ci-feedback-loop
Coding Agent CI Feedback Loop: Agent pushes a branch, polls CI for partial failures, patches the failing files within a retry budget, and notifies when all tests pass
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/coding-agent-ci-feedback-loop
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/coding-agent-ci-feedback-loop.md

### commitment-ledger-reality-gated-credit
Commitment Ledger with Reality-Gated Credit: Records agent promises and credits retrieved memory only after an externally verifiable outcome settles.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/commitment-ledger-reality-gated-credit
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/commitment-ledger-reality-gated-credit.md

### compounding-engineering-pattern
Compounding Engineering Pattern: After each feature, codifies agent mistakes and learnings into CLAUDE.md, slash commands, subagents, and hooks so the next feature is easier to build
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/compounding-engineering-pattern
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/compounding-engineering-pattern.md

### parallel-tool-execution
Conditional Parallel Tool Execution: Runs a batch of tool calls in parallel when all are read-only and in sequence when any modifies state, then returns results in request order
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/parallel-tool-execution
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/parallel-tool-execution.md

### consequence-family-coverage-audit
Consequence-Family Coverage Audit: Audit an agent's risk policy by enumerating families of consequence and asking which rule covers each, because a hand-written risk list reliably encodes one family and stays silent on the rest
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/consequence-family-coverage-audit
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/consequence-family-coverage-audit.md

### context-budget-as-a-governed-resource
Context Budget as a Governed Resource: Measures always-loaded context per source, alerts on trend growth, and puts hard spend caps and fan-out bounds on unattended agent runs
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/context-budget-as-a-governed-resource
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/context-budget-as-a-governed-resource.md

### context-window-anxiety-management
Context Window Anxiety Management: Enables a large context window but caps usage lower, and adds prompts that state the token budget so the model does not rush to finish
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/context-window-anxiety-management
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/context-window-anxiety-management.md

### context-window-auto-compaction
Context Window Auto-Compaction: Catches context overflow errors, compacts and validates the transcript with a reserve token floor, and retries the request automatically
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/context-window-auto-compaction
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/context-window-auto-compaction.md

### context-minimization-pattern
Context-Minimization Pattern: Removes untrusted user text and tool output from context after it becomes a safe structured artifact, so later steps see only trusted data
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/context-minimization-pattern
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/context-minimization-pattern.md

### continuous-autonomous-task-loop-pattern
Continuous Autonomous Task Loop Pattern: Runs a loop where subagents pick the next task from a todo file, execute it in fresh context, commit it, and back off on rate limits
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/continuous-autonomous-task-loop-pattern
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/continuous-autonomous-task-loop-pattern.md

### criticgpt-style-evaluation
CriticGPT-Style Code Review: Runs a specialized critic model over generated code to find bugs, security flaws, and quality issues, and feeds critical findings back for regeneration
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/criticgpt-style-evaluation
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/criticgpt-style-evaluation.md

### cross-agent-lesson-sharing
Cross-Agent Lesson Sharing via Git: Agents write solved problems as markdown lessons in a shared Git repo and search them before debugging, with GitHub Issues as the coordination layer
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cross-agent-lesson-sharing
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cross-agent-lesson-sharing.md

### cross-cycle-consensus-relay
Cross-Cycle Consensus Relay: Each loop cycle reads a structured relay document, does its work, and atomically writes back decisions, open questions, and the single next action
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cross-cycle-consensus-relay
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cross-cycle-consensus-relay.md

### cross-domain-agent-conflict-resolution
Cross-Domain Agent Conflict Resolution: A coordination layer that cross-references recommendations from independent domain agents, detects conflicts on shared resources, and resolves them through policy-as-code.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cross-domain-agent-conflict-resolution
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cross-domain-agent-conflict-resolution.md

### cross-protocol-agent-discovery
Cross-Protocol Agent Discovery: Aggregate agent metadata across fragmented registries and protocols into a unified, protocol-agnostic discovery layer.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cross-protocol-agent-discovery
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cross-protocol-agent-discovery.md

### cryptographic-governance-audit-trail
Cryptographic Governance Audit Trail: Middleware checks each tool call against a policy file, then signs a receipt of the action with ML-DSA and appends it to a tamper-evident chain
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cryptographic-governance-audit-trail
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/cryptographic-governance-audit-trail.md

### curated-code-context-window
Curated Code Context Window: A search subagent finds the few relevant files for a task and injects only top snippets or summaries into the main coding agent's context
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/curated-code-context-window
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/curated-code-context-window.md

### curated-file-context-window
Curated File Context Window: Loads only the primary task files into the main context and has a search sub-agent rank and summarize secondary files before adding them
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/curated-file-context-window
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/curated-file-context-window.md

### custom-sandboxed-background-agent
Custom Sandboxed Background Agent: Builds an in-house background coding agent that runs in sandboxed dev environments, streams progress over WebSocket, and iterates on compiler and test feedback
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/custom-sandboxed-background-agent
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/custom-sandboxed-background-agent.md

### dead-mans-switch-for-scheduled-agent-jobs
Dead-Man's Switch for Scheduled Agent Jobs: Each scheduled job writes a success sentinel to its log, and a separate checker files a task when the sentinel is missing or stale
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dead-mans-switch-for-scheduled-agent-jobs
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dead-mans-switch-for-scheduled-agent-jobs.md

### declarative-multi-agent-topology-definition
Declarative Multi-Agent Topology Definition: Define multi-agent systems declaratively in a single topology file — agents, flows, gates, hooks, group chats — then compile to platform-specific configurations for any agentic framework.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/declarative-multi-agent-topology-definition
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/declarative-multi-agent-topology-definition.md

### democratization-of-tooling-via-agents
Democratization of Tooling via Agents: Non-programmers describe a tool in natural language and iterate with an AI agent that generates and fixes the code for dashboards, scripts, or small apps
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/democratization-of-tooling-via-agents
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/democratization-of-tooling-via-agents.md

### denial-tracking-permission-escalation
Denial Tracking & Permission Escalation: Track repeated tool denials and auto-escalate to blanket permission prompts or fallback strategies, preventing wasted iterations in non-interactive contexts.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/denial-tracking-permission-escalation
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/denial-tracking-permission-escalation.md

### design-time-file-partition
Design-Time File Partition as Concurrency Control: Each task declares every path it will write; overlapping tasks get a blocking dependency so only disjoint work runs at once on a shared checkout
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/design-time-file-partition
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/design-time-file-partition.md

### deterministic-grader-in-the-loop
Deterministic Grader in the Loop: Replace the LLM-as-judge in an agent's self-review loop with a deterministic scorer that returns the raw counts behind each sub-score, so the agent has something specific to fix.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/deterministic-grader-in-the-loop
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/deterministic-grader-in-the-loop.md

### deterministic-security-scanning-build-loop
Deterministic Security Scanning Build Loop: Adds SAST, SCA, and secret scanners to the build target that the agent must run after each change, so scanner failures force the agent to fix the code
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/deterministic-security-scanning-build-loop
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/deterministic-security-scanning-build-loop.md

### deterministic-threat-rule-scanning
Deterministic Threat Rule Scanning: Apply deterministic regex rules as a first-pass security layer to detect known threat patterns in AI agent tool calls and skill definitions.
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/deterministic-threat-rule-scanning
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/deterministic-threat-rule-scanning.md

### deterministic-zero-llm-orchestration
Deterministic Zero-LLM Orchestration: A deterministic code orchestrator splits goals, runs parallel coding agents, verifies with tests, and commits, spending no LLM tokens on coordination
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/deterministic-zero-llm-orchestration
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/deterministic-zero-llm-orchestration.md

### dev-tooling-assumptions-reset
Dev Tooling Assumptions Reset: Audits dev tools for human-effort assumptions and replaces tickets, PR ceremony, and sprints with immediate agent dispatch, variations, and automated tests
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dev-tooling-assumptions-reset
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dev-tooling-assumptions-reset.md

### discrete-phase-separation
Discrete Phase Separation: Splits work into separate research, planning, and implementation conversations, each with fresh context, passing only distilled outputs between phases
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/discrete-phase-separation
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/discrete-phase-separation.md

### disposable-scaffolding-over-durable-features
Disposable Scaffolding Over Durable Features: Treats code around the model as temporary scaffolding: build the simplest thing that works now, mark it disposable, and remove it when models improve
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/disposable-scaffolding-over-durable-features
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/disposable-scaffolding-over-durable-features.md

### distributed-execution-cloud-workers
Distributed Execution with Cloud Workers: Runs many agent sessions in parallel on cloud workers, each in its own git worktree, with dependency-aware scheduling, merge coordination, and approval gates
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/distributed-execution-cloud-workers
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/distributed-execution-cloud-workers.md

### dogfooding-with-rapid-iteration-for-agent-improvement
Dogfooding with Rapid Iteration for Agent Improvement: The agent team uses its own agent for daily work, collects feedback in low-friction channels, and ships features internally first to validate or discard them
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dogfooding-with-rapid-iteration-for-agent-improvement
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dogfooding-with-rapid-iteration-for-agent-improvement.md

### dual-llm-pattern
Dual LLM Pattern: Splits work between a privileged LLM that calls tools but never sees untrusted data and a quarantined LLM that reads untrusted data but has no tools
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dual-llm-pattern
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dual-llm-pattern.md

### dual-rail-message-delivery
Dual-Rail Message Delivery: Sends every inter-agent message on two independent channels through one entry point, alerts when the rails diverge, and requires ACKs to confirm completion
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dual-rail-message-delivery
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dual-rail-message-delivery.md

### dual-use-tool-design
Dual-Use Tool Design: Builds each tool with one interface and implementation that both humans and agents can call, with the same output, permissions, and logs
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dual-use-tool-design
Markdown: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dual-use-tool-design.md

### dynamic-code-injection-on-demand-file-fetch
Dynamic Code Injection (On-Demand File Fetch): Expands @file or /load tokens in the prompt into file contents, line ranges, or summaries so the agent sees code without manual copy and paste
URL: https://agentic-patterns.com/patterns/dynamic-code-injection-on-demand-file-fetch

### evidence-questions-not-verdict-questions
Evidence Questions, Not Verdict Questions: Never ask the model for allow/ask/block. Ask it narrow, typed, observational questions and let code reduce the answers to the verdict, because the collapsed question is the low-confidence one.

Reliability Problem Map Checklist for RAG and Agents: Runs a fixed 16-question failure checklist on each RAG or agent incident, maps the result to repair actions, and re-tests the same failing case

### tracker-as-desired-state-reconciliation

### variance-based-rl-sample-selection
